label: Figure 1.2: Constant opportunity cost (straight-line PPC)
alt: A straight-line production possibilities curve for bicycles and e-scooters with points A, B and C and equal-sized steps between them.
caption: A straight-line PPC for bicycles and e-scooters (thousands per year), running from 8,000 e-scooters to 12,000 bicycles. Moving from A (3, 6) to B (6, 4) to C (9, 2), each extra 3,000 bicycles costs exactly 2,000 e-scooters, so the opportunity cost is constant.
